items.reasons: The narrow 1x2-tile tower is drawn as a flat front elevation. There is no lit counter or top plane, only a grey box with a white cap, a recess holding three coloured nozzles and a cabinet door underneath. At 1x it reads as a vending column, not a drink bar. It is also much narrower and more cramped than the counter originals, and the dark cabinet base sinks into the floor without a clear ground line.

The basket mesh is a noisy checker dither, and its slanted trapezoid sides go diagonal and pseudo-perspective instead of the chipset's straight 3/4 view. Four tall red bars stick straight up like posts rather than reading as nested cart handles. At 1x it is a grey-red smudge that does not read as a cart bay.

The bottles are shown head-on in a dark recess like a flat front elevation. You can't see tiered shelf planks from above, which an open cooler needs. The white top and the red stripes top and bottom copy the counter-register almost exactly, so it reads as a reskinned counter. The heavy black frame boxes in the whole interior, which is heavier than the original cooler's treatment.
